info.title: Apple Cache Server Metrics Report
info.description: Metrics data collected from Apple Content Cache servers.

servers.description: Metrics ingest endpoint (host configured per deployment)

host.description: Hostname or IP of the metrics ingest service

post.summary: Submit a cache server metrics report
post.description: Upload a single CacheServerMetricsReport document describing the state of an Apple Content Cache server and its byte/replies/requests counters since the last report.

version.description: Schema version for tracking migrations and evolution

reportDate.description: Collection timestamp in ISO 8601 format - PRIMARY TIME INDEX

creationDate.description: Collection timestamp in ISO 8601 format for byte count metrics (60-second cadence, only emitted when values change)

memorySize.description: Total RAM in bytes on the cache machine

buildVersion.description: The software version of the cache

uniqueClients.description: Count of unique clients in the collection period

peakClients.description: Maximum number of simultaneously connected clients during the period

transactions.description: Total transaction count since last metric collection

recentErrors.description: Array of recent errors as 'errorCode : reasonCode : count' comma separated triples

cpuLoad.description: Number of threads ready to run (corresponds to the load average reported via top/uptime)

reportPeriod.description: Period of the overall report in seconds

assetsLessThan10M.description: Assets in the cache that are less than 10 MB in size

assetsFrom10to100M.description: Assets in the cache that are between 10 MB and 100 MB in size

assetsFrom100Mto1G.description: Assets in the cache that are between 100 MB and 1 GB in size

assetsMoreThan1G.description: Assets in the cache that are greater than 1 GB in size

averageAssetSizeInM.description: Average size of asset files in the cache in megabytes

registrationState.description: Cache registration status with Apple: Registration Failed (-1), Registration Pending (0), Registration Succeeded (1)

registrationStarted.description: [Optional] Last time registration was attempted (only present when not registered)

registrationError.description: [Optional] Error code from last registration attempt with Apple servers (0 = success)

actualCacheUsed.description: Actual bytes stored (real content) for bandwidth calculations (macOS 10.15+) - distinct from cacheUsed

startupStatus.description: Cache startup completion status (true = finished startup OK)

restrictedMedia.description: Media restrictions enabled for content filtering

tetheratorStatus.description: Tethered caching status: Unknown (-1), Disabled (0), Enabled (1)

activated.description: Cache service activation status (true = ordered to start up)

cacheDetails.description: Human-readable cache breakdown by content type (e.g. "iCloud: 1.83GB Other: 487KB") - keys configured by Apple config bag

cacheFree.description: Available cache space in bytes (derived from cacheLimit - cacheUsed when limit > 0, or DiskFree when unlimited)

cacheLimit.description: Maximum cache size in bytes (0 = unlimited) - administrative limit

cacheUsed.description: Allocated cache space with overhead for capacity management - distinct from actualCacheUsed

privateAddresses.description: Internal network IP addresses as a space-separated list (e.g. "10.10.1.67 10.23.1.83")

parents.description: Array of parent cache server info

peers.description: Array of peer cache server info

personalCacheFree.description: Free space in personal (iCloud) cache in bytes

personalCacheUsed.description: Used space in personal (iCloud) cache in bytes

personalCacheLimit.description: Personal (iCloud) cache size limit in bytes (0 = unlimited)

listenRangesOnly.description: Restrict serving to specific IP ranges only

peerLocalSubnetsOnly.description: Peer with local subnets only (peer filtering)

listenRanges.description: Network IP ranges for client filtering - array of dicts with first/last IP addresses

parentSelectionPolicy.description: Parent selection algorithm: first-available | random | round-robin | sticky-available | url-path-hash

period.description: Metric collection period duration in seconds

bytesDropped.description: Bytes dropped due to errors or capacity issues

bytesFromCacheToChild.description: Bytes served from local cache to downstream child caches

bytesFromCacheToClient.description: Bytes served from local cache to end-user clients

bytesFromCacheToPeer.description: Bytes served from local cache to peer caches

bytesFromOriginToChild.description: Bytes proxied from origin server to downstream child caches

bytesFromOriginToClient.description: Bytes proxied from origin server to end-user clients

bytesFromOriginToPeer.description: Bytes proxied from origin server to peer caches

bytesFromParentToChild.description: Bytes proxied from parent cache to downstream child caches

bytesFromParentToClient.description: Bytes proxied from parent cache to end-user clients

bytesFromParentToPeer.description: Bytes proxied from parent cache to peer caches

bytesFromPeerToChild.description: Bytes proxied from peer cache to downstream child caches

bytesFromPeerToClient.description: Bytes proxied from peer cache to end-user clients

bytesImportedByHTTP.description: Bytes imported into cache via HTTP protocol

bytesImportedByXPC.description: Bytes imported into cache via XPC (inter-process communication)

bytesPurgedYoungerThan1Day.description: Bytes purged that were cached for less than 1 day

bytesPurgedYoungerThan7Days.description: Bytes purged that were cached for less than 7 days

bytesPurgedYoungerThan30Days.description: Bytes purged that were cached for less than 30 days

importsByHTTP.description: Number of content imports via HTTP protocol

importsByXPC.description: Number of content imports via XPC (inter-process communication)

repliesFromCacheToChild.description: Number of replies from local cache to downstream child caches

repliesFromCacheToClient.description: Number of replies from local cache to end-user clients

repliesFromCacheToPeer.description: Number of replies from local cache to peer caches

repliesFromOriginToChild.description: Number of replies proxied from origin to downstream child caches

repliesFromOriginToClient.description: Number of replies proxied from origin to end-user clients

repliesFromOriginToPeer.description: Number of replies proxied from origin to peer caches

repliesFromParentToChild.description: Number of replies proxied from parent to downstream child caches

repliesFromParentToClient.description: Number of replies proxied from parent to end-user clients

repliesFromParentToPeer.description: Number of replies proxied from parent to peer caches

repliesFromPeerToChild.description: Number of replies proxied from peer to downstream child caches

repliesFromPeerToClient.description: Number of replies proxied from peer to end-user clients

requestsFromChild.description: Number of requests received from downstream child caches

requestsFromClient.description: Number of requests received from end-user clients

requestsFromPeer.description: Number of requests received from peer caches

requestsRejectedForNoSpace.description: Number of requests rejected due to insufficient disk space
